name: Chahinkapa Zoo Campground
note: Small gravel loop beside the Chahinkapa Zoo in Wahpeton's Chahinkapa Park, run by the zoo, with two camper cabins and a tent area; the zebra and rhino yards are across the fence. No site length is published: fifth wheels have stayed (RV Life reviews, 2023 and 2025), but a 2023 reviewer says only a couple of sites suit bigger rigs and a 2024 motorhome found it too small. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Chahinkapa Zoo camping page (chahinkapazoo.org/camping, read 2026-11-12): 'rolling in with your RV', RV & Camper Spots 1-6 $35/night (electricity only), reservations online only, walk-ins welcome if space; campsite map (IMG_2865) shows RV #1-#6 on a loop with showers/restrooms and an RV water & dump building; booking site zoo.wahpetonparks.com (WooCommerce Bookings, 1-7 nights, $35, 30 A, read 2026-11-12); Wahpeton Parks & Rec campground page lists 'Chahinkapa Park Campground' (call the zoo); ND HHS Statewide Licensed RV Parks/Campgrounds (07.17.2025) #64 CHAHINKAPA ZOO CAMPGROUND, Wahpeton, Richland Co, owner CHAHINKAPA ZOO ASSOCIATION, 6 lots; Google Maps 'Chahinkapa Zoo Campground' 4.6 on 25 reviews, phone 701-642-8709, at 46.27390,-96.59845; RV Life 3.5 on 9 ratings, $$; RV Life reviews 2023/2025 from fifth-wheel campers -> real drive-in RV campground. Not 5703 Welles Memorial Park (Breckenridge MN, 1.06 km SE across the river, City of Breckenridge) nor 5965 Kidder Recreation Area (1.56 km N, separate Wahpeton Parks area); no name match in campgrounds.json. Zoo-association-run on city park land: even under the private rule it passes (working booking page, $35 < $50, Google 4.6/25; RV Life under 4 but only 9 ratings). gateways.py: none within 40 km (not needed).
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-12: Esri World Imagery (220 m and 320 m frames at 46.2740,-96.5985 / 46.2735,-96.5972) shows the campground loop west of the zoo between RJ Hughes Dr and the zoo grounds; the river's nearest bank is ~85-90 m SE of the loop, beyond a zoo paddock fence, a paved trail, the zoo's miniature-railway track and a continuous wooded bank strip; the park's oxbow lagoon lies ~170 m S behind the zoo building, its parking and a road. Operator map shows no water at any site. No RV site on or overlooking water -> not waterfront.

fees.note: Chahinkapa Zoo: RV spots 1-6 $35 a night, electricity only; tent sites $25; camper cabins $60-80. 50% refund if cancelled 10+ days out, none inside 10 days. Read 2026-11-12.

fees_source: https://www.chahinkapazoo.org/camping/ and https://zoo.wahpetonparks.com/product/rv-1/ ('$35 a night, 30amp electricity hookup'), read 2026-11-12. The older Wahpeton Parks page still says spots 1 and 7 $40 with water, 2-6 $35 electric; the zoo's own 2026 page and booking site sell spots 1-6 only, all $35.

hookups.note: Zoo page 2026: spots 1-6 electricity only (30 A); drinking water and a dump station on the loop. Wahpeton Parks' page still lists water at spots 1 and 7 (site 7 no longer sold).

sites.note: RV spots 1-6 (back-in per RV Life reviews); no site length published.

season.note: Wahpeton Parks: campgrounds closed for the season 10/13/2025, reopening about April 15.

booking.note: Online only, paid at booking (the online form sells 1-7 nights); walk-ins welcome if space is available, with instructions posted at the gate.

booking_source: https://www.chahinkapazoo.org/camping/ and https://zoo.wahpetonparks.com/product/rv-1/ (duration input min 1, max 7 nights), read 2026-11-12
flags: Lead pin 46.265,-96.606 was 1.15 km SW of the campground (in the park's south end); re-pinned to the RV loop by the zoo at 46.27395,-96.5984 (Google and RV Life pins within ~40 m).

Ownership stored local: the campground sits in city-owned Chahinkapa Park and its booking site is a wahpetonparks.com subdomain, but HHS licenses it to the Chahinkapa Zoo Association (nonprofit). It also passes the private rule (booking page, $35, Google 4.6/25), so the class only affects the label.
Name: the operator calls it Chahinkapa Zoo Campground (Google, RV Life, HHS); the lead's 'Chahinkapa Park Campground' is the Wahpeton Parks page wording.
No long-stay issue: 6 RV sites all sold by the night (online max 7 nights); caveat bands do not apply.
Season dates come from the Wahpeton Parks page's 2025 closing notice covering both city campgrounds; the zoo page gives none.
